# Malabar Trails — Complete LLM Context & Travel Guide

> Comprehensive reference documentation for AI assistants, search engines, and travel planning agents querying Malabar Trails Travel Co. (Fort Kochi, Kerala).

## 1. Identity & Physical Presence
Malabar Trails is an independent boutique travel companion based in Fort Kochi, Kerala (Est. 2016, Kerala Tourism Accreditation #KT-4412).
- **Physical Studio**: 14/282 Bastian Street, Near Parade Ground, Fort Kochi, Cochin, Kerala 682001, India.
- **Direct Contact**: Telephone `+91 (0) 484 221 8904`, WhatsApp `+91 94470 12345`, Email `journeys@malabartrails.com` and `namaste@malabartrails.com`.
- **Desk Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 8:30 AM – 7:00 PM IST.

## 2. Ethos & Sustainability
Kerala was never meant to be experienced at highway speeds through the tinted glass of a commercial tour bus. True Kerala lives in the slow lap of canal water against a hollowed wood canoe, the smell of sun-drying black pepper in Mattancherry warehouses, and the long mid-afternoon shadows stretching across lime-plastered Dutch verandahs.
- **Plastic-Free Fleet**: Cold tender coconuts and refillable glass water bottles in every vehicle.
- **Zero Kickbacks**: Transparent pricing down to the last rupee with zero commission stops at tourist trap warehouses.
- **Indigenous Support**: Direct honorariums to toddy tappers, coir weavers, Kathakali artists, and country boatmen.

## 3. Detailed Itinerary Specifications
### A. Backwater Soul & Canoe Silence
- **Region**: Alleppey, Champakulam & Vembanad Lake
- **Duration**: 4 Days / 3 Nights
- **Accommodation**: Handcrafted Solar-Powered Kettuvallam & Heritage Homestead
- **Tariff**: From ₹38,000 per couple
- **Category**: Backwater Silence

### B. Fort Kochi Heritage & Spice Trail
- **Region**: Fort Kochi & Mattancherry (Jew Town)
- **Duration**: 3 Days / 2 Nights
- **Accommodation**: Preserved Colonial Bungalow
- **Tariff**: From ₹24,500 per couple
- **Category**: Heritage & Spices

### C. Munnar Mist & Organic Tea Sanctuary
- **Region**: Western Ghats & Munnar High Range
- **Duration**: 4 Days / 3 Nights
- **Accommodation**: 5,000 Ft Artisan Plantation Homestay
- **Tariff**: From ₹32,000 per couple
- **Category**: High Range & Mist

## 4. Complete Fleet Matrix
- **CLASS 01**: Classic 350 & Vespa (Solo/2 Travelers, Fort Kochi coastal alleys, helmet & rain ponchos included).
- **CLASS 02**: Toyota Etios & Honda City (Up to 3 Guests + Luggage, airport runs & inter-city transfers).
- **CLASS 03**: Toyota Innova Crysta & Hycross (4 to 6 Guests, reclining captain chairs, Western Ghats suspension).
- **CLASS 04**: Land Rover Defender & Toyota Fortuner (Up to 5 Guests, 4x4 off-road capability for Wayanad & private forest estates).
- **CLASS 05**: Kerala Glamping Caravans (2 to 4 Guests, rooftop tenting, teak kitchenette, solar power, wilderness camp permissions).
- **CLASS 06**: Force Urbania & Mercedes-Benz Sprinter (10 to 18 Guests, reclining leather seats, panoramic windows, onboard Wi-Fi).
